name: Cyberpunk
oneLiner: Night-city interface: near-black steel, neon circuitry, monospaced labels, and glow used as a functional signal.
bestFor: developer tools with a strong identity

effects.noise: 4% scanline pattern at 3px vertical pitch, never over body text
effects.glow: 0 0 12px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.45) on focus, active, and live status only

motion.reducedMotion: no flicker, no scanline animation; glow becomes a solid 1px accent border

primary.base: height: 40px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-accent); border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: var(--uiux-color-accent); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase

danger.base: height: 40px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-danger); border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: var(--uiux-color-danger); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase

default.base: position: relative; padding: 20px; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: 4px

display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--uiux-color-textMuted)
width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--uiux-color-success); box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--uiux-color-success)

height: 40px; width: 100%; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--uiux-color-bg); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem
default.focus-visible: border-color: var(--uiux-color-accent); outline: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-accent); outline-offset: 0

default.base: display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 16px; padding: 10px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--uiux-color-textMuted)

do: Build on near-black surfaces and let exactly one neon (cyan) carry interaction and focus.
Use uppercase monospace for labels, units, and data; use a squarish display face for headlines.
Cut one or two panel corners to mark interactive regions instead of adding icons.
Reserve glow for focus, active, and live status so it still means something.
dont: Do not glow every element; if everything is lit, nothing is.
Do not set paragraph copy in a glitch or pixel font.
Do not stack two neon hues on the same control.
Do not put the scanline texture behind body text or form fields.
antiPatterns: Magenta-on-cyan gradient text blocks as the entire page background.
Glitch animation on headings that never stops, triggering motion sickness.
Neon accents on a light SaaS layout — cyberpunk needs the night.

notes: Neon on black easily exceeds 15:1, but thin 12px monospace at that contrast still strains; keep body copy in the sans at 15px.
Glow must never replace a focus ring: keep a 2px solid outline and 2px offset.
Scanline overlays and flicker are vestibular triggers; disable both under prefers-reduced-motion.
